title: docs(adr): ADR-0069 amended in place — per-organization overrides live in the settings tenant rung
body:
Refs #30922
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：只改 ADR-0069 的文字（就地修订，状态行追加一条 2026-11-06 的「Amended in place」）：写明「组织级访问策略覆盖值」存放在设置的租户层（`access_policy` 命名空间，每个组织一行 `sys_setting`），而不是 `sys_organization.*` 字段；涉及 TL;DR 6、D3、D5、D7 四处，并在 D7 末尾加一段说明；另外 D3 的双重验证要求从「开关」改为三档 `off` / `administrators` / `everyone`（不强制 / 管理员必须开 / 全员必须开，管理员即 ADR-0090 D12 的租户级、组织级和委派管理员），部署级是默认值和下限，组织级同样三档、不得弱于部署级（可相同或更强）。
- **为什么改**：执行你在 #30922 上的裁决「修订 ADR 写明存放位置（推荐）」；PR #31013 把这些值存在设置租户层，ADR 原文仍写组织表字段，两者不一致；三档双重验证依据你在 cloud#3668 的裁决「可以，按三档做（推荐）」，一并记入 ADR，免得再开第二个受管 PR。
- **风险与回滚**：零运行时风险，只有文字，没有代码、spec、文档站改动；「组织只能收紧、不能放宽部署下限」这条规则原意不变，其他决策不变。回滚 = revert 这一个提交。
- **先看**：`docs/adr/0069-enterprise-authentication-hardening.md` 的 D7 末尾新增说明段（风险最高：它写了存放位置和理由）；其次 D3、D5 两张表里改名的那一行，以及状态行末尾。
- **两分钟验证**：`git diff origin/main -- docs/adr/0069-*` 应只见状态行末尾、TL;DR 6、D3 两行（存放位置与三档）、D5 一行、D7 一行的改写，加 D7 末尾 1 段新增说明；`pnpm check:adr-index` 应报告 `docs/adr/README.md` 为最新。
- **需要你做的**：审阅后亲手合并（Tier H，草稿状态，席位不会转 ready、不入队、不开 auto-merge）。

## What changes

ADR-0069 is amended in place on the maintainer's ruling recorded on #30922 (ruling record [`6692407743`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/30922#issuecomment-6692407743), maintainer, verbatim: 「修订 ADR 写明存放位置（推荐）」). Per-organization access-policy overrides live in the settings tenant rung of ADR-0007 / ADR-0131: the tenant-scoped `access_policy` namespace, one `sys_setting` row per organization, as PR #31013 implements. TL;DR 6, D3, D5 and D7 named `sys_organization.*` columns. D3's `mfa_required` also changes from a global toggle to the three levels `off` / `administrators` / `everyone`, at the deployment and per organization, on the maintainer's ruling G2 on objectstack-ai/cloud#3668 (verbatim 「可以，按三档做（推荐）」). The tighten-only rule is unchanged in meaning, and no other decision changes.

The diff touches only `docs/adr/0069-enterprise-authentication-hardening.md`. `pnpm adr:index` ran and left `docs/adr/README.md` unchanged (the index shows a truncated status prefix, which this note does not reach), so the README is not in the diff. The status line stays on line 3, inside the index's 40-line header window.

| Passage | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Status line (appended) | no 2026-11-06 note | "**Amended in place** (2026-11-06, ruling record `6692407743` on #30922, maintainer, verbatim 「修订 ADR 写明存放位置（推荐）」; implemented by PR #31013): per-organization overrides live in the settings tenant rung (the tenant-scoped `access_policy` namespace, one `sys_setting` row per organization), not in `sys_organization.*` columns, and D3's `mfa_required` is three levels, `off` / `administrators` / `everyone`, at the deployment (the default and the floor) and per organization (ruling G2 on objectstack-ai/cloud#3668, record `6684194038`, verbatim 「可以，按三档做（推荐）」); the tighten-only rule is unchanged and no other decision changes (TL;DR 6, D3, D5, D7); see the note under D7." |
| TL;DR 6 | "per-org overrides (`sys_organization.*`) are explicit and additive (an org can only *tighten*, never loosen, the global floor)" | "per-org overrides are explicit and additive (an org can only *tighten*, never loosen, the global floor) and live in the settings **tenant rung**: the tenant-scoped `access_policy` namespace, one `sys_setting` row per organization", with a store-amended marker |
| D3, deployment row | "`mfa_required` (global toggle)"; "When `mfa_required`, a session for a user ..." | "`mfa_required` (deployment level: `off` / `administrators` / `everyone`)" with a levels-amended marker; "When the level covers the user (`everyone`: every user; `administrators`: the tenant-level, organization-level and delegated administrators of ADR-0090 D12), a session for a user ...". Default `off`, seam unchanged. |
| D3, per-org row, setting cell | `sys_organization.require_mfa` (per-org) | `access_policy.mfa_required` (per-org, settings tenant rung), with a marker that the column is retired. Seam cell unchanged. The mechanism cell gains "on the same three levels: `off` (nothing beyond the deployment's) or a level at least as strong as the deployment's, never a weaker one (`off`, then `administrators`, then `everyone`)". |
| D5, first row, setting cell | `sys_organization.allowed_ip_ranges` (CIDR[]) | `access_policy.allowed_ip_ranges` (CIDR[], per-org, settings tenant rung), with a marker. Seam and mechanism cells are unchanged. |
| D7, field list | "`sys_organization`: `require_mfa`, `allowed_ip_ranges`" | "per-organization overrides: no `sys_organization` field; they live in the `access_policy` settings namespace", with a marker |
| D7, new closing note | (none) | Records where the values live and that the deployment's `auth` values are the default and the floor. Restates the tighten-only rule. Gives the reason: only a settings write predicate receives the saving request's transport, which the per-organization self-lock-out save guard needs, and the settings rung is the store organization administrators already write. Records that `sys_organization.require_mfa` is retired (readonly, migrated) and that no `sys_organization.allowed_ip_ranges` field is added. |

## Acceptance notes

- The dated implementation-status snapshots are left as written, because they record what was true on their dates: D7's "Implementation status (2026-07-04)" paragraph and the *Phasing* table's P1 and P2 rows still say `sys_organization.*`. The new note says so.
- D3 records the three MFA levels at the deployment and per organization, on the maintainer's ruling G2 on objectstack-ai/cloud#3668 (record [`6684194038`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3668#issuecomment-6684194038), verbatim 「可以，按三档做（推荐）」). The status-line note gains one clause for them. The per-organization row allows a level at least as strong as the deployment's, never a weaker one.
- On purpose, nothing about PR #31013's in-rework mechanics is described here (the concurrent cap, the organization-switch rules).
